description.en: Nepal is a landlocked Himalayan country in South Asia, bordering China’s Tibet Autonomous Region to the north and surrounded by India on the south, east, and west. Famous for the Himalayas and Mount Everest, Nepal is one of the world’s most iconic high-mountain nations. Kathmandu is the political, cultural, and economic center. Nepal’s society is multi-ethnic and multi-religious, and tourism — especially trekking and mountaineering — is a major pillar of its international identity and income.
description.zh: Nepal是位於南亞喜馬拉雅山區的內陸國家，北接中國（China）西藏地區，南、東、西三面則被印度（India）包圍。尼泊爾以壯麗山脈、佛教文化與世界最高峰聖母峰（Mount Everest）聞名，是全球最具代表性的高山國家之一。首都加德滿都（Kathmandu）為全國政治、文化與經濟中心，並具有多民族、多語言與多宗教特色。

seoText.en: Explore quick facts about Nepal — population, area, capital city, and a short overview. Discover Mount Everest, the Kathmandu Valley heritage sites, Himalayan trekking routes, Lumbini, and Nepal’s balance between tourism development and environmental protection.
seoText.zh: 快速了解尼泊爾的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。探索聖母峰、加德滿都谷地世界遺產、喜馬拉雅登山與健行路線、藍毗尼，以及觀光發展與環境保護之間的平衡議題。

list: Core Himalayan mountain country in South Asia
Home to Mount Everest, the world’s highest peak
Deep Buddhist and Hindu cultural traditions
Globally known for trekking and mountaineering tourism
en.text: Nepal’s identity is inseparable from the Himalayas: dramatic altitude changes, sacred landscapes, and iconic mountain routes. Kathmandu anchors governance and culture, while mountain tourism and remittances shape the economy.

list: 位於喜馬拉雅山脈核心地帶
擁有世界最高峰聖母峰
佛教與印度教文化深厚
山岳觀光與登山活動聞名全球
zh.text:
尼泊爾（Nepal）是位於南亞喜馬拉雅山區的內陸國家，北接中國西藏地區，南、東、西三面則被印度包圍。尼泊爾以壯麗山脈、佛教文化與世界最高峰聖母峰（Mount Everest）聞名，是全球最具代表性的高山國家之一。

尼泊爾首都為加德滿都（Kathmandu），是全國政治、文化與經濟中心。尼泊爾歷史長期受南亞與藏文化影響，擁有多民族、多語言與多宗教特色，同時也是世界著名登山與徒步旅遊目的地。

list: Northern South Asia along the Himalayan arc
Himalayas span the entire northern frontier
Extreme elevation differences over short distances
No coastline; transport relies on overland corridors
en.text: Nepal’s north–south range is short, but elevation changes are dramatic. The country includes high snow peaks in the north, hills and valleys in the center, and the Terai plains in the south. Several of the world’s 8,000-meter peaks are within Nepal or along its borders.

list: 喜馬拉雅山脈貫穿全境
zh.text:
尼泊爾國土面積約 14.7 萬平方公里，南北距離不長，但地勢變化極大。

北部為高山與雪峰地區，中部為丘陵與山谷，南部則延伸至特萊平原（Terai Plain）。全球14座超過8,000公尺高峰中，有8座位於尼泊爾境內或邊境地區。

list: Hotter and more humid in the southern plains
Cold conditions persist in high-mountain regions
Monsoon rainfall is a major seasonal driver
en.text: Seasonality is strongly influenced by the South Asian monsoon, bringing heavy summer rainfall that can trigger landslides and floods. High-altitude regions remain cold and snowy for long periods, shaping travel seasons and infrastructure.

zh.text:
尼泊爾因海拔差異巨大，不同地區氣候差異非常明顯。

每年夏季受南亞季風影響，容易出現豪雨與山洪，而高山地區冬季則長期積雪。

list: Population concentrates in valleys and plains
en.text: According to official census figures, Nepal's society comprises over 140 distinct caste and ethnic groups. The largest ethnic and caste categories include the Chhetri (approximately 16.5%), Brahman-Hill (11.3%), Magar (6.9%), Tharu (6.2%), Tamang (5.6%), Newar (5.0%), Kami (4.8%), Musalman/Muslim (4.9%), Yadav (4.2%), and Rai (2.2%). Population concentrates in the Kathmandu Valley and the southern Terai plains. Nepali is the official language, spoken by roughly 44.9% of the population as a mother tongue, followed by Maithili (11.1%) and Bhojpuri (6.2%).

list: 高度複雜的多民族、多語言與多種姓社會
人口高度集中於加德滿都谷地與南部特萊平原
zh.text:
根據尼泊爾官方人口普查數據，全國包含超過 140 個截然不同的種姓與民族群體。其中主要族群比例包括：切特里人（Chhetri，約占 16.5%）、山地婆羅門（Brahman-Hill，11.3%）、馬嘉爾人（Magar，6.9%）、塔魯人（Tharu，6.2%）、塔芒人（Tamang，5.6%）、尼瓦爾人（Newar，5.0%）、卡米人（Kami，4.8%）、穆斯林（Musalman，4.9%）、亞達夫人（Yadav，4.2%）以及夏爾巴人（Sherpas）等山嶽民族。

全國約有 81.2% 的人口信仰印度教，其次為佛教（約 8.2%）與伊斯蘭教（約 5.1%）。官方語言為尼泊爾語（Nepali），約有 44.9% 的人口將其視為母語，其次為邁蒂利語（Maithili，11.1%）與博杰普爾語（Bhojpuri，6.2%）。

list: Tourism is a major income source
Remittances from overseas labor are crucial
Industrial base remains limited by terrain and infrastructure
en.text: Nepal relies heavily on tourism, agriculture, and remittances. Trekking, mountaineering, and religious tourism draw international visitors, while many Nepali workers are employed abroad. Mountain terrain makes infrastructure expansion challenging and costly.

list: 觀光業為重要收入來源
zh.text:
尼泊爾經濟高度依賴觀光、農業與海外勞工匯款。

登山、健行與宗教旅遊吸引大量國際旅客，而許多尼泊爾勞工則前往中東與亞洲其他國家工作。

由於山地地形限制，基礎建設與工業發展相對困難。

en.text: Nepal transitioned from monarchy to a republican system in the 2000s. Political competition, federal governance, and local identity issues remain important drivers of institutional development.

zh.text:
尼泊爾過去長期為君主制國家，2008年正式改制為共和國。

近年政治制度逐漸穩定，但政黨競爭、地方自治與民族議題仍持續影響政治發展。

list: Religion and festivals are central to daily life
en.text: Hindu and Buddhist traditions shape public life and cultural calendars. Remote mountain regions face more difficult access to roads and medical services, while Kathmandu faces rapid growth pressures and urban management challenges.

list: 城市基礎建設仍發展中
zh.text:
尼泊爾社會深受印度教（Hinduism）與佛教（Buddhism）影響，宗教節慶與傳統文化在日常生活中相當重要。

偏遠山區交通與醫療取得較困難，而加德滿都則面臨人口增加與都市壓力問題。

list: Temples and historic towns are culturally dense
Traditional crafts and festivals remain diverse
en.text: Lumbini is among the most important Buddhist pilgrimage sites, linked to the birth of Siddhartha Gautama. Sherpa mountaineering culture and Himalayan exploration history have also made Nepal iconic in global mountain culture.

list: 佛教與印度教文化並存
zh.text:
尼泊爾被視為佛教創始人釋迦牟尼（Siddhartha Gautama）出生地所在地之一，藍毗尼（Lumbini）是重要宗教聖地。

此外，夏爾巴人（Sherpas）登山文化與喜馬拉雅探險歷史，也讓尼泊爾在全球山岳文化中具有特殊地位。

list: Overseas labor migration and youth employment
Balancing tourism growth with environmental protection
en.text: Nepal sits on an active seismic zone, and the 2015 earthquake caused severe damage to infrastructure and heritage sites. Managing tourism while protecting fragile Himalayan environments is an ongoing policy challenge.

list: 經濟發展與基礎建設不足
zh.text:
尼泊爾位於地震活躍帶，2015年大地震對基礎建設與文化遺產造成重大衝擊。

此外，如何在發展觀光產業的同時保護喜馬拉雅自然環境，也是重要政策議題。

list: Pokhara — major mountain-view city and trekking gateway
Mount Everest — the world’s highest peak
en.text: Pokhara is a key base for trekking and mountain tourism. Mount Everest represents an enduring global symbol of climbing culture and Himalayan geography.

list: 加德滿都（Kathmandu）—— 首都與文化中心
博克拉（Pokhara）—— 著名山景與健行城市
聖母峰（Mount Everest）—— 世界最高峰
藍毗尼（Lumbini）—— 佛教重要聖地
zh.text: 博克拉（Pokhara）是尼泊爾重要觀光與登山出發城市，而聖母峰（Mount Everest）則是全球登山文化的重要象徵。

list: Strategic position between India and China
Trade and transit rely heavily on neighbors
Active participation in South Asian cooperation
Tourism and international assistance remain important
en.text: Nepal maintains a balancing diplomacy between India and China. As a landlocked country, it relies on neighbor infrastructure and trade corridors, while tourism and development assistance continue to influence external engagement.

list: 位於中印之間戰略位置
zh.text:
尼泊爾長期在印度與中國之間維持外交平衡。

由於內陸地理位置，對外貿易與交通高度依賴鄰國基礎設施。

en.text: Nepal and Taiwan maintain non-official exchanges. Interaction remains modest, but links exist through tourism, education, and civil society contacts.

zh.text: 尼泊爾與台灣維持非官方交流，雙方在觀光、教育與民間文化領域有一定互動。

list: Home to the world’s highest peak
One of the most iconic Himalayan countries
Sacred geography central to Buddhism and Hinduism
en.text: Nepal stands out through Himalayan geography, dense religious heritage, and globally recognized trekking routes — while also facing development and disaster-risk challenges shaped by terrain.

list: 喜馬拉雅山脈核心國家
zh.text: 尼泊爾以喜馬拉雅地形與宗教文化資產聞名全球，並以登山健行吸引大量旅人；同時，地形限制、基礎建設與天然災害風險也長期影響其發展路徑。

text.en: Mount Everest — the world’s highest peak and a global symbol of Himalayan mountaineering
text.zh: 聖母峰（Mount Everest）——世界最高峰

text.en: Kathmandu Valley — dense UNESCO-listed heritage sites of temples and historic urban fabric
text.zh: 加德滿都谷地（Kathmandu Valley）——世界文化遺產密集區

text.en: Buddhist heritage — deep cultural links to Siddhartha Gautama’s birthplace traditions
text.zh: 佛教文化——釋迦牟尼出生地相關文化深厚

text.en: Trekking — one of the world’s best-known high-mountain hiking destinations
text.zh: 高山健行——全球知名徒步與登山聖地

text.en: Himalayas — core zone of the world’s highest mountain system
text.zh: 喜馬拉雅山脈——世界最高山脈系統核心區域
